title: A run accepts an epic whose [A<n>] items bind no command, then absorbs on predictions it can never score
description:
2jn made 20 item-naming absorption predictions and scored 0: scorePredictions only scores an item that has become runnable, and none of A1-A6 binds a command, so the run produced no calibration evidence for the absorb threshold while tripling the epic's size on the reporter's claim alone. The run (or doctor) should say at start that the epic's predictions will be unscoreable, and the close-out's data should count them as unchecked explicitly rather than by the predictions/ directory's absence.

ticfac run epic-2jn filed this backlog tick from the finding 487ddd7e6b57d0df0147aa9bcdb6760d799a5b63d50da7f4cf1cc9ca3c03b5ca (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-rrl/attempt-54): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/487ddd7e6b57d0df0147aa9bcdb6760d799a5b63d50da7f4cf1cc9ca3c03b5ca.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-09-27 22:47 - ticfac run epic-2jn: created by absorbing finding 487ddd7e6b57d0df0147aa9bcdb6760d799a5b63d50da7f4cf1cc9ca3c03b5ca — a backlog tick: the done is reachable with the finding standing. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/487ddd7e6b57d0df0147aa9bcdb6760d799a5b63d50da7f4cf1cc9ca3c03b5ca.json on epic/2jn, and it says: no classifier prediction could be made — no classifier is configured for gating predictions — so the reporter's own claim decides: it breaks no done item, and the finding is filed to the backlog rather than absorbed. The claim is a prediction, scored later against what the done actually did
